event_name: Document 56 Date 08 September 2019 Time 16:20 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 left the track as a result of the collision caused by Car 5 however Car 18 rejoined the track in an unsafe manner.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty (2 points awarded, 6 points in total for the 12 month period)
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 18, left the track due to the collision at turn 10 however rejoined the track in an unsafe manner forcing Car 10 off the track.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 18 Rejoined The Track Unsafely
